description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' functionality, including various options and edge cases. It contains setup commands, numerous test scenarios, validations, and expected output assertions for the 'git format-patch' command within the Git project.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verifies that the given patch file looks like a valid email with 'From', 'Date', and 'Subject' headers.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Checks the 'From' header in a generated patch matches the provided author name, encoding as necessary.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Adds a sign-off line to the commit message and generates a corresponding patch, then identifies specific lines.

methods.name: signature
methods.description: Generates a signature string for use in the patch headers, based on the current git version and optional input.
